signup.bullet-1: Attendees don't have to sign up.
signup.bullet-3: Personalize your event with an image.

profile-dialog.headline: Profile
profile-dialog.delete-your-account-text-part1: Are you sure you want to delete your account for
profile-dialog.delete-your-account-text-part3:
will be deleted and no one will be able to access them anymore.

There's no way to undo this!
profile-dialog.delete-your-account-text-part4: If you still want to proceed, please confirm by typing 'DELETE ACCOUNT' in the field below.

duplicate-dialog.headline: Duplicate
duplicate-dialog.text-part1: Create a new event based on your existing event
duplicate-dialog.text-part2: All settings will remain the same and you can choose to also copy over the list of people from your original event.
duplicate-dialog.checkbox-copy-all-people: Copy over all people on the list
duplicate-dialog.just-created-text: Hover and click the 'Copy URL' button to get the link to send to your invitees.
duplicate-dialog.just-created-text-mobile: Press the 'Copy URL' button to get the link to send to your invitees.

admins-dialog.headline: Admins
admins-dialog.text:
Admins you add here can edit all fields on your event, just like you can. Only you can archive and delete the event.

Enter the email address of an existing user.
admins-dialog.handover-text_part2:
This means that you will no longer be the owner of the event.

You will remain as admin on the event, but
admins-dialog.handover-text_part3: will have the rights to remove you, as well as deleting the event.
admins-dialog.toast-handover-failed: Couldn't hand over the event. Please try again.
admins-dialog.toast-handover-successful: The event has been handed over to
admins-dialog.toast-user-doesnt-exist: The email address you entered does not have an account on Whoscoming.app

archive-menu.archive-text: Archived events are moved to a separate page to unclutter your main view.

delete-dialog.headline: Delete event
delete-dialog.text-part1: Are you sure you want to delete the event
delete-dialog.text-part2: The event and all of its attendees will be gone forever!

event-builder.back-to-events-creating: Go back? Your event is not created yet and will be lost!
event-builder.back-to-events-editing: Go back? Any changes that are not saved will be lost!

details.frequency-one-off-description: Your event will stay online as is until you change or delete it.
details.frequency-weekly-description: Automatically sets the date of the next event based on the weekday you set. Invitees' attendance status is reset the day after the event.
details.location-placeholder: Where is your event taking place?
details.description-placeholder: Tell your invitees what your event is about...
details.url-description: Your event URL to send to your invitees. We try to auto-generate it based on your event title, but you can change it to whatever you like.
details.url-slug-taken: This URL address is not available. Please choose a different one.

options.edit-menu-description: Each person on the list has an edit menu accessed by pressing the pencil icon. You can customize that menu below (temporarily opened in the preview to let you see your changes).
options.custom-attendee-options-description: Add options if you want inputs from your attendees, for example what type of food they prefer.
options.custom-option-emoji-text-placeholder: Select emoji and write a text...

design.image-description: Personalize your event with a header image.
design.upload-image-hint: Keep in mind that other people will have to load the image, so try to keep the file size down.
design.avatars-description: Add some character to your event by allowing the attendees to select an avatar to be displayed next to their name.
design.confetti-description: Add good vibes to your event! Delight your attendees with the standard, colorful confetti or design your own.
design.confetti-frequency-none-description: Your event is completely free from confetti!
design.confetti-frequency-every-attendance-desc: Every person that registers for your event will get a shot of confetti.
design.confetti-frequency-minimum-attendance-de: The person that fulfills your minimum attendance will be celebrated with a shot of confetti.
design.custom-confetti-description: Replace the default confetti by adding your own styles with custom colors, images and emojis.
design.confetti-image-info-upload: There's currently no image upload, so you'll have to provide your own image URL for now.
design.confetti-image-info-loading: The confetti will only fire once the image has fully loaded, so keep image files as small as possible.
design.max-confetti-styles-reached: No more confetti styles for you!
design.confetti-frequency-minimum-attendance-in: Shoots confetti for the person who fulfills your minimum number of attendees.

labels.event-language-info: Choose the language your invitees see the event in. You can rephrase some of the labels below.
labels.default-enough-attendees-info: Shown instead of the number of missing attendees once the minimum attendance is reached.
